regressions.details: No frozen criterion was met less often in the new variant. New was 3/3 met on every criterion; old had one miss on U02-3 and one on U03-1.

stability_assessment: Within this exploratory n=3-per-variant sample, the new variant was internally stable at 14/14 in all three runs. The old variant was not internally stable: run counts were 13, 14, and 13, with different isolated misses. The between-variant advantage was therefore not repeated at every run index (differences of +1, 0, +1 criteria met), so durability beyond this small sample is not established and no statistical significance is claimed.
limitations: This is a literal-output workflow assessment against the frozen rubric, not certification of medical, statistical, guideline, or journal-style correctness.
Only the allowlisted cases, rubric, six result.md files, and six run-log.json files were used.
Run logs are executor self-reports and were used only as supporting statements, not as complete independent tool traces.
No absent fact, unavailable-file content, external source identity, completed edit, render, or verification was inferred.
The sample has only three runs per variant; totals are descriptive and do not support a claim of statistical significance.
